All checks pass. The repair is complete:

## Summary

**Fixed/extended `/workspace/submission`** (13 entries, 33.5KB, within all bounds):

| Module | What it now does |
|---|---|
| `formats.py` | Strict envelope validation (int tokens, duplicate keys, depth/size bounds, all per-field bounds) → `{"error":"invalid_request"}` |
| `offline_discovery/rule_generate.py` | **Exact** fragment extraction (strict `> mean+σ` test via integer squaring, maximal runs, width-window max-sum with earliest-tie *including the final legal window*) and exact clustering: neighbor test `SD·9ᴬ·q² ≤ p²·25ᴬ·L` vectorized over pairs, core = `bit_count ≥ max(2,⌈m·ratio⌉)`, components on cores, noncore attachment to the component with the smallest core fragment ID, noise; generalized intervals `[max(0,trunc(lo−σ)), min(3028,trunc(hi+σ))]` computed exactly with `isqrt` |
| `offline_discovery/rule_remove.py` | Calibration via numpy bitmask window stabbing (row counts once per pattern), exact Fraction `score = Cin/(Cout+1/10000)`, `kept ⟺ score > threshold`, priority by decreasing exact score then cluster ID |
| `online_matching/train_rf.py` | Pinned `DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=10, random_state=42, class_weight='balanced')`, native-node certificates `[class]` / `[feature, 2·threshold, left, right]`, frozen predictor (left iff `2·feature ≤ 2·threshold`) |
| `online_matching/match_p4.py` | Range banks (entry per kept cluster) and exact banks (Cartesian products excluding 1514 at every coordinate, identical keys merged, distinct keys clipped at `capacity.exact+1` via bounded enumeration); priority bitmask matcher over sliding suffix windows |
| `sessions.py` | Atomic installs (`oversize`/`busy`/`ok`, previous-current eviction iff unreferenced, close-time eviction of unpinned noncurrent banks), flow epochs (first-packet direction, nondecreasing timestamps even post-classification, idle-before-consumption precedence, earliest-packet segment commits with `rule`/`start`, strict `> packet_limit` fallback, backup on first `width` features with 1514 padding), classified epochs still pinning banks, end-of-input close enforcement |
| `pipeline.py` / `run.py` | Integration, fragment budget enforcement, one JSON response |

**Validation performed**: public fixtures pass through the real `check.py` flow in bounded children (`public_checks_passed`; this dev sandbox denies the runner's own `setsid`/`kill` calls, so the identical flow was run with a shim that only removes those two OS calls); 3000+ randomized differential tests against an independent naive Fraction-based reference covering discovery, clustering, calibration, tree, exact-key counting and replay; 38 invalid-input classes; hand-derived idle/limit/segment/pin/busy/oversize/epoch scenarios; worst-case runtime under scored limits ≈ 38s (1GiB AS verified) of the 120s budget.
